Mr Hezekiah initially dispatched 20 trucks. A quarter of these trucks had mechanical failures, which is $ \frac{1}{4} \times 20 = 5 $ trucks. Therefore, $ 20 - 5 = 15 $ trucks successfully delivered the fertiliser. Each truck was carrying 20 tons of fertiliser, so the total amount of fertiliser that reached the farmers is $ 15 \times 20 = 300 $ tons.  
FINAL_ANSWER: 300
